# Native Rectangle geometry probe

Unchanged MIT `forticheprod/py-aep` sources pinned at
`e12a451c35bacd3f34a080090265f9370e66162b`; SHA-256 and byte sizes are in
`provenance.json` and checked by the Rust regression.

Target: composition **14, `PROBE_MAIN`**, layer **40, `shape_rect`** in
`geometry_probe.aep`. The separate upstream `geometry_rects_probe.json` records
Adobe `sourceRectAtTime` results. Upstream
`tests/read_only/test_layer_geometry.py` documents the AE-generated probe and
its relationship to this AEP; the oracle is not generated by the FX renderer.

The fresh-import test checks the native FX Rect's editable Size, anchor and
single owned Stroke against `shape_rect/t0_noext`: left −50, top −25, width
100, height 50. No generated outline script or Node evaluation is needed for
this case. It also validates the fresh serialized FX document.

This establishes selected native static Rectangle parameter/bounds conversion,
not Adobe image equality, stroke-inclusive bounds, animated Rectangle parameters,
reverse-direction traversal or fidelity of the other layers in this multi-case probe. No
Adobe application was launched here. External media is not needed for this target;
other imported layers may retain explicit unsupported/missing-media diagnostics.
